title: GaitiLab/scrnaseq-cellcomm-pipeline pipeline parameters
description: Inference of cell-cell communication using scRNAseq data.

scrnaseqcellcomm_modules.description: available modules in scrnaseq-cellcomm-pipeline as described above. Use a single string to specify modules and separate modules by a comma (default='prep_data,run_cci,consensus,aggregation')

cci_tools.description: Tools to run, string with tools separated by a comma (default='cell2cell,cellchat,cellphonedb,liana')

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input_file.description: Path to Seurat object containing multiple samples.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

cell2cell_db.description: Path to the Cell2Cell database (formatted from ref_db)

cellchat_db.description: Path to the CellChat database (formatted from ref_db)

cellphonedb_db.description: Path to the CellPhoneDB database (formatted from ref_db)

liana_db.description: Path to the LIANA database  (formatted from ref_db)

ref_db.description: Path to the CCI reference database same as cellphonedb_db, cellchat_db, liana_db, cell2cell_db, but in a generalized format.

metadata_csv.description: Path to metadata from Seurat object (input_file) stored as csv

metadata_rds.description: Path to metadata from Seurat object (input_file) stored as res

sample_var.description: Column in metadata of Seurat object containing the Sample IDs

annot.description: Column in metadata of Seurat object containing the cell type labels.

skip_reduction.description: Skip reduction of Seurat object size, i.e. only keeping required assay

min_cells.description: Minimum number of cells required in each cell group for cell-cell communication

min_pct.description: Minimum percentage of cells expressing a gene, used in LIANA & CellPhoneDB, but is actually a proportion, a value between 0 and 1.  (default = 0.1; 10% of cells)

n_perm.description: Number of permutations, used in all available CCI tools.

consensus_and_aggregation_options.title: Consensus and aggregation options
consensus_and_aggregation_options.description: Parameters used in the consensus and aggregation module of scrnaseqcellcomm

condition_var.description: Grouping variable for your samples. Used for **3. CCI Filtering & 4. CCI Aggregation** for comparison of multiple conditions (or groups). If there is no 'condition' for your dataset, use the default. Then aggregation/filtering will be done based on Patient (or Sample, in case Patient = Sample).

patient_var.description: Column in Seurat object's metadata with a patient ID. In case a patient has multiple samples, if not set then the following assumption is made Patient=Sample.

min_patients.description: Minimum number of patients for an interaction to be kept (used in **3. CCI Filtering**).  If only 1 sample per patient, then uses the sample IDs

alpha.description: Significance level to use for filtering of interactions in the consensus module

interactions_excel_name.description: Name for Excel file when export_as_excel is set to true

export_as_excel.description: Boolean whether to save the overview of the aggregated/filtered interactions as an Excel file

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
